desc:
EARLY ACCESS – this is an early build of Scooter Hub. Expect bugs and rough edges; new scooters, places and features come with every update.

Ride realistic electric scooters through a German town, its fields and forests, and a full motorway ring around the whole map.

• 5 electric scooters, from a free starter to 120 km/h hyper scooters
• Real physics: wheelies, drifts, hard braking, crashes
• Customize your ride: paint, wraps, stickers, underglow, glass deck
• Earn money for every kilometre, wheelie and daily quest
• Day and night, rain, traffic, pedestrians – and police that chase you
• First-person view and photo mode for your clips
• PC, phone and controller

PC controls: WASD ride, Shift wheelie, P garage, TAB map.

Found a bug? Tell us through the Social Links on this page. Thanks for testing!
